messages:
alex: Heads-up — customers on EU region are getting slow embeddings and some 400s with `dimension_mismatch` today. Noticed requests are being routed to us-east during peak. Can someone check routing/pool spillover?
maria: Which customer / example request id? Any pattern on batch size or model variant?
alex: Customer is `acme-inc`, request_id `req_eu_79b2`. Payloads are 1536-d vectors expected, some responses say 1024. Batching=auto, single requests and small batches (<=8).
tyler: Looks like a model variant mismatch — some nodes still serve a 1024-d quantized variant for the same model name. That would cause `dimension_mismatch`. I can pull node labels.
sre-oncall: Also seeing capacity alarms for eu-west-1 pool  — autoscale didn't spin up fast enough; fallback policy routed to us-east which has the 1024 variant. Cold starts + routing = wrong model variant served.
alex: Repro steps I ran: `curl -X POST /v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"model":"edge-embed", "input":"foo"}'` -> 200 but dims 1024. When I force `region=eu-west-1` header we get 1536. Logs attached (excerpt):
```
2026-03-15T10:21:14Z request=req_eu_79b2 routed_region=us-east-1 model=edge-embed variant=quant-1024 latency_ms=60
2026-03-15T10:21:15Z request=req_eu_79b3 routed_region=eu-west-1 model=edge-embed variant=fp16-1536 latency_ms=1800 cold_start=true
```
maria: That lines up. Cold-starts in eu-west cause routing fallback. We should not fallback to a different variant; fallbacks must pick compatible variant or honor dimensional schema. I'll open a config ticket for fallback policy.
tyler: For a quick mitigation, we can add a routing rule to prefer same-dimension variants or fail closed on dimension mismatch. I'll push a small policy change to staging.
sre-oncall: Also see billing anomalies — `billing-bot` reports spike in cross-region egress for embeddings this morning. @billing-bot can you confirm customers billed for inter-region fallback?
billing-bot: Confirmed. Between 09:00-11:00 UTC we saw +22% cross-region egress for embeddings, mostly eu-west -> us-east. Metrics attached.
alex: Customer impact: higher latency (1.5s to 2s), some apps got `dimension_mismatch` and handled as errors. Raised a P0 to support queue and notified Acme.
maria: Action items: 1) short-term: disable cross-region fallback for embeddings when variant dims differ; 2) mid-term: ensure eu pools have warm standby capacity to avoid cold starts; 3) add model-dim metadata to routing decision. I'm assigning to @tyler and @sre-oncall.
tyler: On it — will push a routing guard and an emergency safe-fail that returns 429 instead of wrong-dim 400 if mismatch detected. Deploy ETA 40m.
sre-oncall: I'll scale up eu-west pool and hold until routing guard is live. Also capturing traces: span `trace_0a1b2c` for req_eu_79b2 for the diagnosing team.
alex: Thanks. I'll keep Acme updated and add repro commands in the ticket. If anyone needs the full logs I uploaded them to the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2026-embed-routing-eu
maria: One more note — add an eval to detect silent dim changes during rollouts. We saw a rollout where variant labels didn't match model contract.
alex: Agreed. Closing loop: ticket #SUP-2026-114 created and linked. Will post update after Tyler's push. :thumbsup:
